title: Machine-learning-assisted prediction and optimization of tensile strength in particulate-filled polymer composites
summary: LASSO, K-nearest neighbors, support-vector regression and genetic-algorithm-optimized SVR were compared for tensile-strength prediction in metal-powder/resin composites. Evaluation used nested five-fold cross-validation on 45 experimental conditions, so performance is bounded to this dataset.
ai_technology: LASSO, KNN, SVR and GA-SVR regressors
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: A 45-condition metal-powder/resin composite dataset was used to predict tensile strength; nested five-fold cross-validation compared the models.
evidence.unknown: Small dataset; cross-validation is internal and does not establish performance on independently produced composites.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO, KNN, SVR and GA-SVR regressors

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
